book.title: 1934: Caught in the Crossroads
book.tagline: A relic from the Crusades resurfaces, threatening a world already on the brink.
description: Europe, 1934. The scars of the Great War have not healed, and something older has begun to surface beneath the politics of the age.

When an archaeological discovery in Yugoslavia hints a trail toward a lost fragment of the True Cross, Nazi operatives move to seize it. Four unlikely allies are drawn into a race across a continent sliding toward ruin.

A war veterann, his actress sister, a disillusioned archaeologist, and a German scholar cast out by the new regime race through Yugoslavia, Austria and Rumania through archives, ruins, monasteries, and hidden places.
The relic is more than an artifact, it's history. In the wrong hands, it could become a weapon of power, myth, and belief.
1934: Caught in the Crossroads is a historical adventure about ideology, memory, and the people caught between the collapsing world behind them and the one rushing forward to replace it.
